commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command 'cmd /d /c "executable.cmd --help > pyhelp.txt"; $ref=(Get-Content REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -Raw).Trim(); cmd /d /c "`"$ref`" --help > refhelp.txt"; if((Get-FileHash pyhelp.txt).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash refhelp.txt).Hash){'"'HELP EXACT'}else{Compare-Object (Get-Content refhelp.txt) (Get-Content pyhelp.txt)}; @'
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile('plain.zip','w') as z:z.writestr('hello.txt','hello')
open('bad.zip','wb').write(b'not a zip')
'@ | python -; foreach("'$f in @('"'plain.zip','bad.zip')){foreach("'$which in @('"'ref','port')){"'$o="$which.$f.out";$e="$which.$f.err"; if($which -eq '"'ref'){cmd /d /c \""'`"$ref`" -i $f 1>$o 2>$e"}else{cmd /d /c "executable.cmd -i $f 1>$o 2>$e"}; Write-Output "=== $which $f code=$LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content $e -Raw}}; Remove-Item pyhelp.txt,refhelp.txt,plain.zip,bad.zip,ref.*.out,ref.*.err,port.*.out,port.*.err'
